                            EXTRAORDINARY SESSION

 ª                                                        2



                            P R O C E E D I N G S

                             THE PRESIDENT:    The Senate will

                  please come to order.

                             I ask everyone to please rise and

                  repeat with me the Pledge of Allegiance.

                             (Whereupon, the assemblage recited

                  the Pledge of Allegiance to the Flag.)

                             THE PRESIDENT:    With us this

                  afternoon to give the invocation is the

                  Reverend Peter G. Young, from Blessed

                  Sacrament Church in Bolton Landing.

                             REVEREND YOUNG:    If I may take

                  the liberty of presenting again the same

                  prayer that I gave in the last extraordinary

                  session just five years ago.

                             Dear Senators, we pray for all of

                  our New York State people that their wealth

                  and power might become a force for peace

                  rather than conflict, a source of hope rather

                  than discontent, as an agent of change, of

                  friendship rather than enmity.

                             May the actions of this Senate be

                  that example.  We ask You this in Your name

                  forever and ever.

                             Amen.
